name: Death Drain
body:
You become better at using Deathbane Touch, and can even use it as part of a melee attack.

Prerequisite: Obitu, Deathbane Touch

Benefit: You can use Deathbane Touch up to 3 times per day. In addition, as part of a melee attack that deals damage, you can enlist the effects of Deathbane Touch in addition to any damage dealt. Using this ability in conjunction with a melee attack counts towards the number of uses per day.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
